name: Battle Smith
summary: A protector and healer who fights alongside a mechanical steel defender.

features.name: Tool Proficiency
features.summary: You gain proficiency with smith's tools.

features.name: Battle Smith Spells
features.short: Smite and support spells that are always prepared.
features.summary: You always have certain spells prepared after you reach particular levels in this class. They don't count against the number of artificer spells you prepare.

features.name: Battle Ready
features.short: Martial weapons; use INT to attack with magic weapons.
features.summary: You gain proficiency with martial weapons. When you attack with a magic weapon, you can use your Intelligence modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for attack and damage rolls.

features.name: Steel Defender
features.short: A loyal construct companion that protects you.
features.summary: You build a steel defender that obeys you and acts on your turn. It can make a force-empowered rend (1d8 + PB force) and use its reaction to impose disadvantage on an attack against a creature within 5 ft. Its hit points equal 2 + INT modifier + 5 x your artificer level. You command it with a bonus action.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.short: Attack twice with the Attack action.
features.summary: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Arcane Jolt
features.short: On a hit, add 2d6 force or heal someone 2d6.
features.summary: When you or your steel defender hit with a magic weapon attack, you can deal an extra 2d6 force damage or restore 2d6 hit points to a creature within 30 ft. of the target. Uses: Intelligence modifier per long rest, once per turn.

features.name: Improved Defender
features.summary: Arcane Jolt's extra damage and healing become 4d6. Your steel defender gains +2 AC, and its deflect reaction deals 1d4 + INT force damage to the attacker.
